scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm workspace:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm build:shared && pnpm dev:links && pnpm --parallel --filter @incidentlens/web --filter @incidentlens/api --filter @incidentlens/worker run dev
scripts.dev:poll: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm build:shared && pnpm dev:links && cross-env TSC_WATCHFILE=DynamicPriorityPolling TSC_WATCHDIRECTORY=DynamicPriorityPolling WATCHPACK_POLLING=true pnpm --parallel --filter @incidentlens/web --filter @incidentlens/api --filter @incidentlens/worker run dev:poll
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/runtime build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/api dev
scripts.start: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm build && pnpm dev:links && pnpm --parallel --filter @incidentlens/web --filter @incidentlens/api --filter @incidentlens/worker run start
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test:unit && node --test scripts/workspace.test.mjs
